device: RTX 5060 Laptop GPU selected by scripts/chrome-gpu.mjs
method: Same frozen reference view at (400,80,600) looking at (1100,15,1550), 1440x960. Before image emulates the previous cutoff by hiding overview/ocean, setting camera far 900m and fog 250..650m in the same build; HUD belongs to the new profile. After enables distant terrain/coastal ocean, far 4000m and fog 1200..3500m. Captures are qualitative coverage checks, not an old-build FPS comparison.

validation.terrainGrid: Every original boundary sample retained; holes retain full topology or reject beyond candidate geometry budget.
validation.lifecycle: Hide/restore detailed keys, source failure/retry, retained budget rejection, ignored cancellation, independent borrowed assets, zero tracked renderer allocations after the native distance fixture.

limits: Reference land remains 2x2km. No distant forest HLOD or authoritative distant collision. Generic overview does not render water; reference example adds one bounded coarse Standard ocean. Geometry counts exclude shared textures, water resources, transient project payloads and driver overhead. Larger authored worlds need adequate far tile/byte budgets. No new FPS measurement, full browser suite or other-device validation.
